skill.summary: Swiss-knife for AI agents. 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, emai...

latestVersion.changelog:
SkillBoss 1.3.0 significantly simplifies usage with a new direct API and removes all Node.js script dependencies.

- Replaces all local Node.js client scripts with simple, copy-pasteable cURL examples
- Adopts a new API base URL: `https://api.heybossai.com/v1`
- Updates authentication to use only `SKILLBOSS_API_KEY` environment variable
- Removes documentation and code for local scripts, error handling, and API integration references
- Refactors and expands docs for every model/task category, with real API request/response samples
- No more requirement for Node.js or any local setup; skill now uses pure HTTP API calls
